summary: Optional bounded read-only Ollama-backed repository inspection.

provides.name: read-only-delegate
provides.summary: run_delegate coordinates bounded read tools; ollama_complete isolates HTTP and is replaced by deterministic response fixtures in tests.

artifacts.name: provider-alias-configuration
artifacts.summary: Adjacent model aliases and endpoint, with OLLAMA_BASE_URL endpoint override; model configuration is not observed runtime identity.

invariants.statement: Read-tool paths stay inside the selected repository and outputs are bounded; no write or shell tools are granted.
Incomplete, invalid, error, or empty final responses do not become completed inspection results. Review text is advisory evidence.
